Definition: from G2316; godlike (neuter as noun, divinity):-- divine, godhead.
BiblicalUsage: theîos is the Bible's word for divine, godlike. In Acts 17:29, Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God. That is the sense it carries through all 3 of its occurrences.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that what is divine is not distant or abstract; in Christ the divine came close enough to touch. That is why theîos stays with me long after the verse is closed.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
